question.text: The number of geometrical isomers of $\mathrm{CH}_{3}-\mathrm{CH}=\mathrm{CH}-\mathrm{CH}=\mathrm{CH}-\mathrm{CH}=\mathrm{CHCl}$ is

solution.text: The given structure has three double bonds whose each carbon atom is differently substituted hence number of geometrical isomers will be $2^{n}=2^{3^{\prime}}=8$, where $n$ is the number of double bonds whose each carbon atom is differently substituted.
